// @path: src/lib/ops/operations.ts
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// The near miss the PR4 import widening invites. @/lib/familyCodeMint is on the
// allowlist because it is one function over an alphabet and node:crypto.
// @/lib/familyCode is NOT: it asks the database whether a candidate code is
// already in use, so it reads Parent rows and holds the identifier in a
// `where:` clause. Importing it would pull all of that into the ops walk in
// order to reuse four lines of string building.
import "server-only";
import { uniqueFamilyCode } from "@/lib/familyCode";

export async function mint() {
  return uniqueFamilyCode();
}
